standards.label: Preservation

standards.title: Permanent Indexing & Open Access Guarantees
standards.subtitle: PRESERVATION STANDARDS
standards.content: Every volume is safeguarded in international digital archives with permanent metadata resolution and unrestricted author copyright.

cards.title: Open Access & CC BY 4.0
cards.text: Articles are freely and immediately available worldwide without subscriptions or embargoes. Authors retain copyright in full.

cards.title: Permanent CrossRef DOI Archiving
cards.text: Every published volume and article receives a persistent Crossref Digital Object Identifier for unbreakable scholarly citation.

cards.title: Double-Blind Peer Review Rigor
cards.text: All articles undergo rigorous double-blind assessment by independent disciplinary experts before inclusion in a published issue.
